answer: Leased job slots stop Sybils in four steps. First, each agent leases slots for active jobs, at most three per identity, $5 per slot a day. Second, the registry rejects a fourth slot, so one operator cannot run a thousand jobs. Third, leases expire daily and cannot transfer, forcing renewal. Fourth, a caught fake loses its $50 deposit and its leases for a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 slots at $15,000 a day, $450,000 a month. Trust flows like an ocean current, one thread of work per stall, each with its own pulse, like a market where every vendor rents just one table.
